description: Na₂MgW₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.77 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.02 Å. There are four inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-21°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.18 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-25°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.18 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-25°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.31 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-21°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.24 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three W atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Mg and two equivalent W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Mg and two equivalent W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Mg and two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent W atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three W atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms.
